dailyBrief: In a significant leadership shift, Demis Hassabis has transitioned from CEO to Chairman of Google DeepMind, while co-founder Jeff Dean has announced his departure, raising questions about the future direction of the AI powerhouse. Meanwhile, a former OpenAI employee is venturing into ambitious territory by developing telepathy technology, highlighting the growing trend of AI professionals pursuing groundbreaking innovations outside traditional frameworks. On the business front, Mirendil has secured a $100 million deal with Google Cloud to enhance its self-improving AI capabilities, signaling a robust demand for scalable AI solutions. Additionally, recent analyses suggest that large language models (LLMs) will not compromise symmetric cryptography, reassuring businesses about the security of their data in an increasingly AI-driven landscape.
